links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to patient questions about ICI-associated myocarditis (FKGL)
links.effect: Readability was suboptimal, with mean FKGL of 16.60 ± 2.64 across 100 responses from five LLMs; significant inter-model differences in readability.
links.quote: Readability was suboptimal, with a mean FKGL of 16.60 ± 2.64.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, reliability, and readability of responses generated by five LLMs to standardized patient questions regarding immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
